channel.description: Latest articles from The Garden Island (thegardenisland.com)

item.title: Suspicious activity in Kapaa reported
item.description: LIHUE — The Kauai Police Department (KPD) has issued a press release responding to reports of social media posts describing an alleged attempted kidnapping in the Kapaa area.

item.title: EDITORIAL: Push opportunity to halt corruption
item.description: One of the most difficult but necessary steps in recovering from disaster is committing to evaluate and re-order practices that could lead to repeated harm. That’s where we are, as a state, in the recovery effort necessary after the shocking corruption scandal that rocked the Legislature in 2022, and with aftermath shock waves now emerging.

item.title: One injured in collision Monday morning
item.description: OMAO — Police responded to a three-vehicle crash Monday morning near the intersection of Kaumualii Highway and Omao Road.

item.title: Hawaii beach access bill stalled after universal outcry
item.description: Public lands — including beaches in front of hotels and resorts — will remain open to the public after a Senate committee on Wednesday deferred a bill that drew near universal condemnation.

item.title: HerbieGives football camp on March 7
item.description: KAPAA — Registration for the third annual HerbieGives All-Position Football Camp are now being accepted for all age groups, as well as for Girls Flag Football Camp.

item.title: Planned new telescopes for Haleakala draw strong opposition
item.description: As the military moves forward on its plans to build as many as seven new telescopes on the summit of Haleakala, opposition to the project is mounting on Maui.

item.title: Tax break halt still alive, gambling bills dying in Hawaii Legislature
item.description: Efforts to legalize any form of gambling again appear dead this year but the state Legislature continues to move bills that would eliminate future tax cuts, limit free school lunches to public charter students and prohibit ICE and local law enforcement from covering their faces.

item.title: KIF names 2025-2026 Swimming All-Stars
item.description: LIHUE — Kauai High School earned the Central Pacific Bank Kauai Interscholastic Federation boys and girls team championships according to the KIF Swimming All-Stars list that was released on Monday.

item.title: An exchange of lifesaving knowledge and culture
item.description: LIHUE — The Kauai Ocean Safety Bureau (OSB), in partnership with the Okinawan Lifesaving Association, hosted a certificate ceremony on Friday at the Moikeha Rotunda.

item.title: DOW awards 2025 employees of the year
item.description: LIHUE — Albert Cadavona, Chrysanthemum “Christine” Erorita and Joseph “Jay” Perreira, Jr., were named the Department of Water’s 2025 Outstanding Employees of the Year during the Kauai Board of Water Supply’s (KBWS) monthly board meeting Thursday.
